name: Toriko no Urara ~Otoko no Sono ni Magirekonda Ichirin no Akai Hana~
original_name: 虜ノ麗 ～男の園に紛れこんだ一輪の紅い花～
source:
Yagami Tsubasa is a high school girl living alone. After her parents passed away, she used to live with her older sister, Sawa, but when Sawa was assigned as a teacher at a boys' boarding school, Kousei Private Academy, they became separated.

Even though being apart, they were still in contact with each other, however......
One day, Tsubasa suddenly loses contact with Sawa.
Despite filling for a missing person, or making various inquiries at the school, the search does not progress.

Together with her best friend Mizumori Sei, they start to look for Sawa themselves, and eventually end up finding out numerous unpleasant rumors about the school.

The groundless rumors on the Internet...... After reading these unpleasant contents, Tsubasa is afraid that Sawa's disappearance will be buried in the dark, so she becomes desperate.

She thinks about moving into the school and start looking on her own, but even so, there is still a big problem. Because, Kousei Academy is a "boys' school," while Tsubasa is a "girl."

So Tsubasa comes up with the idea of "dressing up and moving in as a boy." It appears to be reckless, but with Sei's help, she is able to infiltrate the school as a boy under the name Yagawa Tsubasa.

As she continues her search, she meets an art teacher who is Sawa's best friend, Urabe Kanna, and a girl who happens to be at the school for some reason, Yui Noeka, little by little​, she gets closer to the truth.

Sawa is almost within her reach......but at that moment, Tsubasa's identity is revealed to a certain opponent. A man who is deeply involved with the dark side of the school, now completely under his thumb, Tsubasa has to do what he orders......

And so, will Tsubasa be able to reunite with Sawa?
Or perhaps, will both her body and soul be corrupted in this Garden of Men......

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonourara/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
八神翼是一位独居的女高中生。父母去世后，她曾与姐姐泽一起生活，但当泽被分配到私立男子寄宿学校高生学园当老师时，她们就分居了。

虽然分开了，但他们还是有联系的，然而……
有一天，翼突然与泽失去联系。
尽管填补了失踪人员的姓名，或者向学校进行了各种询问，但搜寻工作却毫无进展。

他们和她最好的朋友水森诚一起开始亲自寻找泽，最终发现了关于学校的许多不愉快的谣言。

网络上的无端谣言……读完这些不愉快的内容后，翼担心泽的失踪会被埋在黑暗中，所以她变得绝望。

她考虑搬进学校，开始自己寻找，但即便如此，仍然有一个大问题。因为，公成学园是“男子学校”，而小翼是“女子学校”。

于是小翼萌生了“打扮成男孩一样搬进去”的想法。看似鲁莽，但在圣的帮助下，她能够以男孩的身份潜入学校，名叫矢川翼。

在继续寻找的过程中，她遇到了泽最好的朋友美术老师浦部环奈，以及因某种原因碰巧来到学校的女孩结衣野香，渐渐地，她越来越接近真相。

泽几乎触手可及……但就在这时，翼的身份暴露给了某个对手。一个深深卷入学校黑暗面的男人，现在完全在他的掌控之下，翼必须按照他的命令去做……

那么，翼能否与泽重逢呢？
又或许，她的身体和灵魂都会在这人之花园中被腐蚀……
